title: Transpose calculation for a normalized adjunction square with arbitrary comparison maps
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal A_v,\mathcal B_v,\mathcal E,\mathcal F,\mathcal E_v,\mathcal F_v$ be categories. Fix functors $q_A:\mathcal A\to\mathcal E$, $q_B:\mathcal B\to\mathcal F$, $q_{A_v}:\mathcal A_v\to\mathcal E_v$, $q_{B_v}:\mathcal B_v\to\mathcal F_v$, $r_0:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A_v$, $s_0:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B_v$, $r:\mathcal E\to\mathcal E_v$, $s:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F_v$, and $G_v:\mathcal B_v\to\mathcal A_v$. Use the unit and Hom-transpose conventions of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Fix adjunctions $F:\mathcal A\rightleftarrows\mathcal B:G$, $L:\mathcal E\rightleftarrows\mathcal F:R$, $L_v:\mathcal E_v\rightleftarrows\mathcal F_v:R_v$, with units $\eta^0,\eta,\eta_v$ and Hom bijections $\mathsf T_0,\mathsf T_D,\mathsf T_v$ from left-adjoint morphisms to right-adjoint morphisms. Write $a;b$ for first $a$, then $b$.
Fix natural transformations $\alpha:Lq_A\to q_BF$, $\iota:q_AG\to Rq_B$, $\iota_v:q_{A_v}G_v\to R_vq_{B_v}$, $\tau:r_0G\to G_vs_0$, $\theta:L_vr\to sL$, $\beta:rR\to R_vs$, and natural isomorphisms $\rho:rq_A\cong q_{A_v}r_0$, $\zeta:sq_B\cong q_{B_v}s_0$. Suppose for every $A\in\mathcal A$, $I\in\mathcal B$ and $h:FA\to I$ the global Hom normalization holds:
$$\mathsf T_D(\alpha_A;q_Bh)=q_A(\mathsf T_0(h));\iota_I.$$
Suppose also, for all $X\in\mathcal E$ and $I\in\mathcal B$,
$$\eta_{v,rX};R_v(\theta_X)=r(\eta_X);\beta_{LX},$$
$$r(\iota_I);\beta_{q_BI};R_v(\zeta_I)=\rho_{GI};q_{A_v}(\tau_I);\iota_{v,s_0I}.$$
Then for every $A\in\mathcal A$ one has the following equality of morphisms from $r(q_AA)$ to $R_v(q_{B_v}(s_0FA))$:
$$\mathsf T_v\bigl(\theta_{q_AA};s(\alpha_A);\zeta_{FA}\bigr)=\rho_A;q_{A_v}\bigl(r_0(\eta^0_A);\tau_{FA}\bigr);\iota_{v,s_0FA}.$$
The transformations $\alpha,\iota,\iota_v,\theta,\beta,\tau$ need not be invertible, and no localization, exactness, flatness or resolution hypothesis is imposed on these categories and functors.

source.place: Tag 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), normalized Hom bijection; agent-written categorical transpose calculation extracted from Steps 4–5 of lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-pullback-mate-normalization. The square formula is not asserted verbatim by Stacks.

proof.text:
Fix $A\in\mathcal A$. The unit formula for the Hom bijection in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] gives $\mathsf T_0(1_{FA})=\eta^0_A$ and $\mathsf T_D(\alpha_A)=\eta_{q_AA};R(\alpha_A)$. Apply the assumed global Hom normalization with $I=FA$ and $h=1_{FA}$; since $q_B(1_{FA})=1_{q_BFA}$, it yields
$$\eta_{q_AA};R(\alpha_A)=q_A(\eta^0_A);\iota_{FA}.\tag{1}$$

source.place: Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint), following paragraph: unit and the equivalent descriptions (1) and (2) of corresponding morphisms; agent-written substitution and naturality calculation.

proof.text:
Put $c_A=\theta_{q_AA};s(\alpha_A);\zeta_{FA}$, a morphism $L_v(r(q_AA))\to q_{B_v}(s_0FA)$. Expand its transpose using the unit formula in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] and the functor law for $R_v$, and substitute the assumed unit square at $X=q_AA$:
$$\mathsf T_v(c_A)=\eta_{v,r(q_AA)};R_v(\theta_{q_AA});R_v(s(\alpha_A));R_v(\zeta_{FA})=r(\eta_{q_AA});\beta_{L(q_AA)};R_v(s(\alpha_A));R_v(\zeta_{FA}).$$

source.place: Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint), following paragraph: unit and the equivalent descriptions (1) and (2) of corresponding morphisms; agent-written substitution and naturality calculation.

proof.text:
Naturality of $\beta:rR\to R_vs$ at the morphism $\alpha_A:L(q_AA)\to q_B(FA)$ is exactly
$$\beta_{L(q_AA)};R_v(s(\alpha_A))=r(R(\alpha_A));\beta_{q_B(FA)}.$$
Substitute this into Step 2 and combine the first two factors using the functor law for $r$:
$$\mathsf T_v(c_A)=r(\eta_{q_AA};R(\alpha_A));\beta_{q_B(FA)};R_v(\zeta_{FA}).$$

source.place: Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint), following paragraph: unit and the equivalent descriptions (1) and (2) of corresponding morphisms; agent-written substitution and naturality calculation.

proof.text:
Substitute (1) in Step 3, expand $r$ of a composite, and use the assumed right augmentation square at $I=FA$. Associativity gives
$$\mathsf T_v(c_A)=r(q_A(\eta^0_A));r(\iota_{FA});\beta_{q_B(FA)};R_v(\zeta_{FA})=r(q_A(\eta^0_A));\rho_{GFA};q_{A_v}(\tau_{FA});\iota_{v,s_0FA}.$$

source.place: Tag 0037 (definition-adjoint), following paragraph: unit and the equivalent descriptions (1) and (2) of corresponding morphisms; agent-written substitution and naturality calculation.

proof.text:
Naturality of the forward map of $\rho:rq_A\cong q_{A_v}r_0$ at $\eta^0_A:A\to GFA$ says
$$r(q_A(\eta^0_A));\rho_{GFA}=\rho_A;q_{A_v}(r_0(\eta^0_A)).$$
Replace these two factors in Step 4 and combine the next two factors by functoriality of $q_{A_v}$. This gives
$$\mathsf T_v(c_A)=\rho_A;q_{A_v}(r_0(\eta^0_A);\tau_{FA});\iota_{v,s_0FA},$$
the required equality in $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal E_v}(r(q_AA),R_v(q_{B_v}(s_0FA)))$. The calculation uses no inverse of any comparison map.
